description: Get the stored AI-written overview of one CVE: one paragraph on what the flaw is, what it affects, what an attacker can do, whether it is exploited and how to fix it, written by Hinoki Offensive One from the entry's source data. Overviews are written only when someone opens the CVE page on vulnerable.now, so this tool reads and never writes one. status says whether the paragraph is ready, stale (the sources changed since), missing or still being written. AI text can be wrong; check get_vulnerability and the sources. The same JSON as GET /api/v1/entries/{id}/overview.

id.description: A CVE ID, such as CVE-2024-3400. GHSA, EUVD and OSV IDs resolve to their CVE when it has one.

name: get_overview

fresh.description: True when the paragraph was written from the current source data.

overview.description: text, model and generated (an ISO time).

reason.description: Why there is no current overview: disabled, not_eligible, cooldown, hourly_limit, daily_limit or busy.

title: Read the AI overview
